# Text

## Text

The text atom. A caller names a type set (`type: 'heading03'`) and a color leaf (`color: 'text_secondary'`); the theme supplies the family, size, line height, weight, tracking and color, so the same `Text` reads as each template's typography without a change.

### Decisions

- **The type is a contract leaf.** `type` takes any `type.` leaf the contract defines, not a fixed list of names; a leaf the theme lacks throws at render. The default is `body_compact_02`, the reference's own default.
- **Color is a token, never a value.** `color` takes a color leaf; the default is `text_primary`.
- **Break mode.** `head`, `middle` and `tail` render a single line with the ellipsis at that position; `wrap` or no break mode wraps freely.
- **No geometry.** The spec sheet is empty: everything Text draws comes from the type set and the color token.

The row carries no roster flags.

### Platform

Both. React Native's text element renders on iOS, Android and web; the family token names a font the host installs.

## Text

Text draws one run of text in the type set and color token a caller names, and cuts a single line with an ellipsis when asked.

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | no | Text to render. When absent, `children` render instead. |
| `children` | `node` | no | Content to render when `text` is absent. |
| `type` | `string` | no | Type set leaf under `type.` (`body_compact_01`, `heading03`, `label01`, `code01`, ...). Default `body_compact_02`. A leaf the theme lacks throws. |
| `color` | `string` | no | Color token leaf under `color.`. Default `text_primary`. |
| `breakMode` | `string` | no | Where a single line is cut: `head`, `middle` or `tail` render one line with an ellipsis there; `wrap` or absent wraps freely. |
| `accessibilityRole` | `string` | no | Role forwarded to the text element, for example `header` for a heading. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the text element. |
| `style` | `object` | no | Style merged last (layout only; type and color are props). |

### Metrics

None: every value this component draws is a token named in its props or listed under `tokens`.

Color leaves accepted: `text_primary`, `text_secondary`, `text_placeholder`, `text_helper`, `text_error`, `text_disabled`, `text_inverse`, `text_on_color`, `text_on_color_disabled`, `link_primary`.
